Applied AI Engineer
Inviso is partnering with one of our clients to find an experienced Backend / Platform Engineer to join their team working remotely. Inviso is managing the recruitment and placement process for this opportunity. This is a remote, direct-hire permanent employee position for our client that is a global multi-billion dollar software conglomerate.

The Applied AI Engineer is responsible for building and operating AI capabilities across an enterprise platform, including agent runtimes, model routing, RAG, tool/function calling, guardrails, evaluation, monitoring, cost management, latency optimization, and production quality controls.

Experience & Skills Required
Experience shipping software backed by LLMs, ML models, RAG systems, or agentic workflows to real production users.
Experience designing or implementing agent runtime, orchestration, model routing, tool/function calling, or AI workflow patterns.
Strong understanding of RAG, grounding, retrieval quality, prompt design, context management, and evaluation approaches.
Experience building evaluation harnesses, golden sets, regression checks, quality gates, or measurable AI performance frameworks.
Ability to treat cost, latency, reliability, and safety as first-class engineering constraints.
Experience building guardrails and controls for AI systems, including untrusted retrieved content, tool output risk, and failure modes.
Strong communication and collaboration skills for client-facing consulting environments.

Desired Qualifications
Experience with Claude, GPT, Azure OpenAI, open-source models, model routing, fine-tuning, distillation, or small/edge models.
Experience with MCP, A2A, multi-agent orchestration, AI tool calling, or agent evaluation.
Experience with LLM-as-judge approaches calibrated against human evaluation.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong review, testing, and safety discipline.
